title: EchoAI-Peds multi-task deep learning model analyses pediatric echocardiography
summary: A video-based vision transformer trained on over 700,000 videos from more than 11,000 Stanford studies detects 28 congenital heart defects and related findings from complete multi-view pediatric echocardiograms. Its macro-averaged AUROC was 0.91 (95% CI 0.90-0.92) on an internal held-out set and 0.89 (95% CI 0.88-0.90) on a distinct cohort at the Children's Hospital of Philadelphia, outperforming adult echocardiography foundation models. Retrospective preprint.
ai_technology: Video vision transformer for multi-task pediatric echocardiography analysis

evidence.tested: Internal held-out test and an external cohort from a different hospital and time period.
